3.2.3.4 QM calls QM
This caller-callee combination is only supported if the involved BSW QM partitions
share the same memory access rights or the BSW QM modules are modified to en-
capsulate cross-partition calls in CallTrustedFunction wrappers. This however
violates the initial assumption for this approach to reuse existing BSW modules without
modification.
